title: The shorter the cut, the harder the ending
text: The YT may end calm; the FB ends on a defiant line, an accusation or a verdict; the 1-min ends on the punch or the shocking number. Every day that uses ORANGE ends the YT on it; YELLOW makes up more of the 1-min than of the YT.

source.heading: Candidates from the overnight study (2026-11-23, none confirmed)
